# Vendored third-party code

`imagetracer.js` is ImageTracer 1.2.5 by Andras Jankovics, copied unchanged from the jspaint project's `lib/imagetracer_v1.2.5.js`. It is released into the public domain under the Unlicense (see the licence text at the top of the file). It is used by `ai-paint trace` to turn a bitmap into smooth vector outlines.
